heroHeadline: Pope Leo Returns to St. Peter's Square in Popemobile Eight Days After Lung Cancer Surgery
heroSubtitle: On October 13, 2026, the Vatican disclosed that a nodule removed from Pope Leo's lung during surgery was found to be malignant. The Vatican had initially confirmed the surgery was successful before revealing the cancerous diagnosis — a major development with global implications for the Catholic Church and 1.4 billion Catholics worldwide.
footerNote: Data sourced from Vatican News, Holy See press office statements, Al Jazeera, Le Monde, Reuters, and AP. Medical updates reflect official Vatican communications only.
